actual_scope: Can the mirror of the hosted native be merged jointly with the forward network on more ports (Y components, X units, Y tails, X heads, shared helpers), with the complete signed invoice improving?
scope_change_reason: Same root, caller, hosted pair, deletions and BIT pin as #6886 (built on #6883 and #6884). Changed: the word. Direct reads of Y by mirror helpers change on 42 ports and direct writes into X on 51 ports, 8 fewer public registers, 116 fewer MOVEs, gate blocks rebuilt. Correctness rests on the exact replay of the final word. The claim is above main's admitted BIT saving and ordinary stock; the pin used is .00376669 of the open #6726, which the ledger needs only to exceed kappa + 4 gap (archive-only values .0034597, .003475458 and .003483969976 also pass). Raw count 982,697,752 on actual work (under 10^9) and 1,022,800,096 on the conservative count (over, as since #6883); the growth bound is written. Inherited: owned ascent (A6, 23 events of rank mass 56, one owned read of a main Y register), the endpoint literal, LAMBDA and IDLE_ONE, the root family, the idle pricing.
bottleneck_link: docs/research/research-family-status.md; complete signed native/caller invoice and all supplier-admission gates
stop_rule: The claim is conditional on the five retained framework assumptions, the declared owned ascent (A6), and a BIT saving above kappa + 4 gap that main has not admitted (the pin used is .00376669 of the open #6726; archive-only values of #4760, #4814 and #5512 also pass the ledger); no claim above the pin; the conservative raw count is over 10^9 and is stated.
